frequency_question: How often do states under ongoing aerial bombardment successfully stand up domestic production of complex cruise or ballistic missiles within 3 years of initial technical integration agreements?
membership_rule: Includes state-level programs to locally manufacture advanced cruise/ballistic munitions previously solely imported from allies during active interstate conflict.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic drone/maritime drone scaling (Magura V5 / Sea Baby)
Ukraine domestic production of Bohdana artillery systems
Ukraine domestic cruise missile development (Neptune mass production ramp)

provenance_note: 4 cases named, 5 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 4 named major instances of successful rapid domestic scaling of complex weapon systems under wartime constraints; approximately 1 total notable failure or severe delay observed (e.g. specific Western joint-venture delays).
known_gaps: Extremely sparse historical base rate for high-tech cruise missile co-production under active total war conditions outside of Ukraine's current conflict.
skeleton: Defense industrial base adaptation programs in active high-attrition conflict
multiplier: 4 observed major initiatives / 5 total attempted major missile/heavy system local industrialization efforts
validity_reason: Base rate tied to modern wartime industrial adaptation capacity, which remains relatively stable through the current technological era.
